title: instrument token-phase profiles and adaptive logging bridge
author: Maya Patel
body:
Summary: Add token-phase profiling (phase = request_rewrite|kv_lookup|decode|encode) metrics, a compact per-invocation sparkline panel for token cost vs phase-latency, and an adaptive logging bridge that attaches enriched token-phase context to sampled logs/traces. Motivation: long-tail latency and cost issues frequently correlate with particular request phases (e.g., heavy KV cache churn during prefix warmup). Existing dashboards show per-invocation totals but lack phase decomposition and an actionable path to raise higher-fidelity logs only for problematic phase patterns. This PR introduces phase tagging in the runtime spans, exposes new metrics and rollups, and wires a bridge that can attach contextual logs only for invocations matching configurable phase heuristics.

What changed: single continuous description of changes and rationale.
- Serving runtime: add PhaseSpan annotations (phase_name, phase_index, phase_duration_ms) on invocation traces; lightweight emitter that aggregates per-invocation phase durations to metrics backend. Implementation is 0 overhead in the fast path unless a phase histogram is enabled.
- Metrics: new timeseries: invocation.phase.duration.p50/p90/p99 (labels: model, tenant, route, phase_name), invocation.phase.token_cost (estimate per-phase token cost), invocation.phase.count. Added a short-lived histogram rollup job to produce sparkline-friendly downsampled sequences for dashboard sparklines.
- Logging bridge: adaptive-logging-controller that subscribes to metric rollups and trace events; when phase patterns cross configured thresholds (e.g., decode p99 > 120ms while kv_lookup p90 > 40ms) it requests an elevated sampling policy for matching tenant/route for the next N minutes and attaches a phase_context payload to sampled logs and traces.
- Dashboard: new compact tile: "Phase Cohort Sparkline" (per-route toggle) and an "Invocation Phase Waterfall" modal that shows per-token phase breakdown for sampled traces.
- Tests and docs: unit tests for PhaseSpan lifecycle, integration test simulating a heavy kv warmup, and a new console docs snippet showing how to enable the sparkline tile and configure adaptive logging thresholds.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add phase span annotations in runtime
- [x] Export metrics with labels (model, tenant, route, phase_name)
- [x] Add sparkline rollup job and dashboard tile
- [x] Implement adaptive logging bridge + config UI hooks
- [x] Unit + integration tests
- [x] Docs snippet for console

review_comments: Diego Rivera: Can we guard the PhaseSpan allocation behind a runtime flag to ensure zero-allocation on older runtimes?
Maya Patel (author): PhaseSpan is pooled and falls back to a no-op marker when disabled; added microbench numbers to the runtime test.
Priya Shah: The metrics label cardinality looks ok but add tenant redaction for SSO-provided tenant ids.
Maya Patel (author): Added tenant hashing and redaction in phase_metrics.go; updated docs to call out hashed tenant ids.
Liam O'Connor: For the adaptive-logging controller, ensure we can't escalate sampling for super-high-cardinality routes without a quota check.
Maya Patel (author): Controller now consults quota API before temporarily raising sampling; added an integration test for quota denial path.
ci_checks: E2E: pass (console tile rendered in headless)
merge_summary: Squashed and merged after two approvals. No rollout blocker. Feature gated behind observability.phase_profiles flag; default off for small customers.
release_notes: Add phase-level invocation metrics and a Phase Cohort Sparkline dashboard tile; introduce adaptive logging bridge to selectively enrich logs for suspicious phase patterns. Feature is behind the `observability.phase_profiles` feature flag.
notes: Backported minimal PhaseSpan no-op to 2024.10 release branch via hotfix pr-189988. Observability and SRE teams to coordinate enabling for high-volume tenants first.
